name: BioHazard Title
epitaph: The first singles belt on the fed's champions page, beside the Demon Seed title. That page, stamped 12 January 2009, lists its champion and #1 contender as 'None'. On the first card (11 August 2008) Alexander Loveless unveils it from under a cover in the ring and the announcers hope for 'our first Bio Hazard Champion'; on 3 February 2009 he names Nos and Thomas Evans co-number-one contenders for it at Vengeance for Valentines. No champion is recorded.
notes: The fed's own belt as its pages name it, never a real company's belt; no reign of it is recorded.

name: Demon Seed Title
epitaph: The fed's second singles belt, named on its champions page and in its wrestler applications ('Singles (BioHazard Title and Demon Seed Title)'). The champions page, stamped 12 January 2009, lists the Demon Seed Champion and its #1 contender as 'None'. No champion is recorded.
notes: The fed's own belt as its pages name it, never a real company's belt; no reign of it is recorded.

name: ChaosBlood Title
epitaph: The fed's hardcore belt: its application form offers 'Hardcore (Chaosblood Title)' as a division, and Thomas Evans and Brian Larsen apply for it. Its champions page, stamped 12 January 2009, lists the ChaosBlood Champion and its #1 contender as 'None'. No champion is recorded.
notes: The fed's own belt as its pages name it, never a real company's belt; no reign of it is recorded.

name: Attitude Tag Titles
epitaph: The fed's tag belts, named 'Tag Team (Attitude Tag Titles)' on its application form; its champions page, stamped 12 January 2009, lists two tag-team champions and two tag-team #1 contenders, all 'None'. No champion is recorded.
notes: The fed's own belt as its pages name it, never a real company's belt; no reign of it is recorded.
